paragraphs: Rabbi Yose Tzaydena: meaning his occupation was making nets, or he was from Sidon. In Rabbi Yochanan’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 4, mishnah 3. Tzayyana asked before Rabbi Yirmeyah: end of Terumot. Tzaydena disputes with Rabbi Yirmeyah: Almanah Nizonet, halakhah 7, and Nazir, Kohen Gadol, halakhah 3. See Rabbi Yosef above.
